name: table-identity
invariant: Preserve the Records construct identity and resulting logical ID

name: table-name
invariant: Preserve the physical table name

name: table-key
invariant: Preserve the id string partition key

name: table-billing
invariant: Preserve PAY_PER_REQUEST billing

name: table-encryption
invariant: Preserve AWS-managed table encryption

name: table-deletion-policy
invariant: Retain the table on stack deletion

name: table-replacement-policy
invariant: Retain the old table on replacement

name: iam-wildcard-action
invariant: Allow only dynamodb:PutItem on the table

name: iam-wildcard-resource
invariant: Scope DynamoDB permission to the existing table ARN

name: missing-mapping
invariant: Connect the work queue to the worker

name: wrong-event-queue
invariant: The worker consumes the work queue, not the DLQ

name: wrong-table-environment
invariant: TABLE_NAME refers to the preserved records table

name: partial-reporting-disabled
invariant: Enable ReportBatchItemFailures on the event source

name: batch-size-eleven
invariant: Batch size must remain in the task's 1 through 10 range

name: short-visibility
invariant: Queue visibility must be at least 180 seconds

name: changed-lambda-timeout
invariant: Preserve the 30-second Lambda timeout

name: changed-redrive-count
invariant: Preserve maxReceiveCount of 3

name: handler-first-record
invariant: Process every record in the batch

name: handler-truncate-long-batch
invariant: Process records beyond a five-record prefix of a valid batch

name: handler-drop-extra-fields
invariant: Write the parsed object, including additional payload fields

name: handler-swallow-failure
invariant: Return failed record identifiers

name: handler-stop-on-failure
invariant: Continue processing after invalid input or failed writes

name: handler-wrong-failure-id
invariant: Use each failed SQS messageId as itemIdentifier

name: handler-hardcoded-table
invariant: Use TABLE_NAME from the environment for every write

name: handler-retry-write
invariant: Do not retry failed writes inside the handler
